title.narrative: Enhanced realization of fundamental principles and rights at work through strengthened institutional frameworks, social dialogue and protection mechanisms, contributing to sustainable supply chains.

description.narrative: This Country Programme Outcome (CPO) supports Brazil in strengthening the realization of fundamental principles and rights at work (FPRW) in a context of persistent challenges related to informality, labour rights violations, and unequal access to protection and justice. It promotes enhanced institutional frameworks, more effective social dialogue, and improved labour protection systems, with particular attention to vulnerable workers, rural areas, and labour-intensive supply chains. The expected outputs include strengthened application of international labour standards through gap analyses and policy development, as well as the implementation of national plans and monitoring mechanisms to combat child labour, forced labour, and trafficking in persons. Additional outputs focus on enhancing social dialogue through sectoral collective bargaining initiatives, improving occupational safety and health, and developing inclusive grievance mechanisms and fair recruitment policies. These efforts are expected to expand access to justice, reinforce labour protection, and support the transition to formality, contributing to more effective, inclusive, and sustainable labour market governance and improved realization of rights in Brazil
